newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE MIDFIELDER ZELIC OUT FOR A MONTH WITH KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE MIDFIELDER ZELIC OUT FOR A MONTH WITH KNEE INJURY.

text.p: Auxerre's Australian libero Ned Zelic, injured in the 10th minute of his team's goalless draw against Nancy in the French League on Saturday, will be out of action for at least a month with a knee injury, a team doctor said on Sunday.

Zelic, 25, who joined Auxerre this season from Frankfurt, after a brief spell at Queens Park Rangers in England, will miss next week's league match against Nantes and the European champions league match in Glasgow against Celtic on September 25.
The injury is all the more troublesome for the French champions as they are already without sweeper Franck Silvestre and left back Franck Rabarivony, who are both injured.
